data.title: Make a short gas simulation preview
data.summary: A 1 m gas domain, a 12-frame source pulse and a 72-frame preview. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Fluid workflows distinguish liquid and gas domains, flows and effectors.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender / MuJoCo environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A 1 m gas domain, a 12-frame source pulse and a 72-frame preview.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent smoke burst workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A 1 m gas domain, a 12-frame source pulse and a 72-frame preview. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Configure a gas domain and a bounded smoke source with explicit start/stop frames
Cache at low resolution and inspect the domain boundary before adding detail
Compare density and lighting under one fixed camera on an authorized renderer

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned make a short gas simulation preview candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Smoke does not clip unintentionally at the domain edge
The source stops emitting after the specified pulse
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: Smoke appearance is highly lighting-dependent and does not predict ventilation or exposure.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.

tips: Record cache resolution and frame range beside the preview.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me make a short gas simulation preview in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A 1 m gas domain, a 12-frame source pulse and a 72-frame preview. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Smoke does not clip unintentionally at the domain edge; The source stops emitting after the specified pulse. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
